headline: US SEC Probes Nvidia Accounting Practices Amid Corporate Scrutiny
summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has launched an investigation into Nvidia's accounting practices, according to sources familiar with the matter. The probe adds to ongoing legal challenges facing the chipmaker.
why: Nvidia is the world's premier designer of artificial intelligence hardware and one of the largest companies by market capitalization globally.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia faces regulatory pressure from an SEC investigation into its accounting practices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of an SEC investigation into Nvidia's financial accounting heightened investor caution regarding the chipmaker's governance.
